subject: SOC 2 / SIG: SCIM reconciliation & least-privilege verification for Borealis Health
messages:
From: Asha Patel <ashap@borealishealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@borealishealth.com>, Borealis Security <security@borealishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + least-priv checks for SOC 2 window

Hi Rishi — thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SOC 2 readiness sprint the auditors asked for the following from Redwood for our tenant: 

1) SCIM delta export showing account changes (30–90 day window)
2) SAML assertion samples for federated logins that show NameID and group claims
3) Evidence of role-to-group mappings and the owner of each role (RBAC owner list)
4) A short least-privilege checklist for service accounts and admins

Can you confirm whether you can provide CSV/ZIP artifacts and an owner contact list by EOD next Friday (2026-05-21)? We can accept redacted PII but need timestamps and actor IDs.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Manager, Security Assurance
Borealis Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <ashap@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + least-priv checks for SOC 2 window

Asha — appreciate the clear ask. We can deliver the artifacts you listed. Quick plan and owners: 

- SCIM delta export (CSV): Sean will run a scoped extraction and supply a delta CSV with timestamps and user IDs; we will redact emails per your guidance. (owner: sean@redwood.com)
- SAML assertion samples: Marissa will pull assertion logs and include 5 representative samples across IdPs. (owner: marissa@redwood.com)
- RBAC owner mapping: Laura and I will produce a role->group->owner mapping and note any service-account bindings. (owner: laura@redwood.com)
- Least-priv checklist: I'll attach a short checklist and our recommended mitigation steps; we can walk through it on a quick call.

Deliverable timeline: draft artifacts by Wed 2026-05-20 EOD, final packaged ZIP by Fri 2026-05-21 EOD unless you need earlier. If you prefer, we can stage a Drive folder and push interim files as they are ready.

Could you confirm redaction rules (full email removal vs hashed ID) and whether auditors need original assertion raw text or redacted samples?

Thanks — assigning Sean and Marissa to this thread.

—Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <ashap@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + least-priv checks for SOC 2 window

Hi all — brief technical note on the SCIM extraction and what we'll include: 

- Scope: Borealis Health tenant only; window 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-31 (60 days) as requested.
- Fields: user_id, external_id (hashed), action (create/update/delete), actor_id (service or admin id), timestamp, source (SCIM/API/service).
- Redaction: By default we'll replace email addresses with a salted SHA256 hash and keep user_id stable for correlation. If auditors require masked emails we can provide a mapping under an NDA.
- Format: CSV (borealis_scim_delta_20260531.csv) and a short manifest describing extraction queries and schema.

I will also include a small script we used to pull deltas and a link to an S3-styled staging location. Expected first drop: 2026-05-18 (interim), final package 2026-05-21.

Action items for Borealis: confirm you are OK with hashed emails (salted) vs email removal, and whether the auditors need original assertion text for SAML samples.

Sean
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: borealis_scim_delta_sample_header.txt (1 KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <ashap@borealishealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + least-priv checks for SOC 2 window

Asha — for the SAML assertion samples I'll provide:

- 5 raw assertions (redacted where necessary) showing NameID, SessionIndex, audience, and group claims. File: saml_assertion_samples_20260505.txt
- A short mapping doc that shows which assertions correspond to which login flows (SSO via Okta, Azure AD).

Note: Some customers require we strip org-specific identifiers; we can produce both raw and redacted if you prefer. Also attaching a quick RBAC snapshot (leastpriv_checklist_redwood.xlsx) that explains role owners and service-account bindings.

If Borealis security wants a 30‑minute review call, I can walk through the samples Friday morning.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: saml_assertion_samples_20260505.txt; leastpriv_checklist_redwood.xlsx
From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@borealishealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + least-priv checks for SOC 2 window

Thanks team — hashed emails are acceptable to our auditors as long as the same hash is used throughout the artifacts and the manifest explains hashing. They do want one unredacted SAML assertion off-record (delivered under an auditor NDA) to validate claim formatting; everything else can be redacted.

Also: auditors asked us to confirm service-account TTLs and whether API keys are rotated automatically. Can you flag any long-lived keys in the RBAC snapshot? If yes, an action note would be great.

Tom
Senior Compliance Analyst
Borealis Health

- Deliver interim SCIM delta CSV by 2026-05-18 and final package (CSV + SAML samples + RBAC mapping + checklist) by 2026-05-21.
